name: mammoth
title: The Mammoth
description: The Mammoth: a big ship built round a woolly mammoth's cockpit, a 4 m by 8 m hull with a rounded nose (room behind the seat for an airlock and stores). Behind it sit a 2 m generator and a 2 m battery; a fuel-and-oxidiser tank on each side, either of which feeds every engine; four engines, two a side on outriggers, the front pair outboard of the rear so their exhaust clears; a railgun in the nose firing 0.5 kg explosive shells; and, at the tail, a tractor projector and a separate tether generator. Without the tether generator the beam still pulls but nothing can be towed. About 280 kg; at full thrust 6.5 m/s², like the lander, but being four times as long it turns about half as fast (0.55 rad/s after half a second on one side, against the lander's 1.3). It flies on with one engine out, or one each side, at half thrust.

ui.lookFor: Fly with Q and E; F fires the railgun; hold T to beam, and bring a piece within 25 m to tow it. It pushes like the lander but swings round slowly: start a turn early and check it early. Shoot away an engine and keep flying by tapping the stronger side. Try the shell mass, the tether length and the weld strength.
